items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: the bass player that you met down in Annapolis, Rusty Gilder

ctx.x: That's not really the question I meant to ask you, (LAUGHTER) I realised I repeated, I meant to ask you who was going to be there with you? But anyway, what did you find out today?

Well I'll tell you first the bass player that you met down in Annapolis, Rusty Gilder and a very good young drummer named Joe (Corcello?) who has worked with me. But what I found out today was that I'm going to be on the Newport Jazz Festival with my own group. And George said, let's not have a trio, why don't you augment the group and have some horn players which made me very excited because this really gives me a chance to do something that I want to do. And the second thing was that he's going to devote at…
rather some of the groups, some of the bands that he's put together, highschool bands and kids from the New York area will be playing at the 'Alice Tully' Hall.
